# Contact Us


For general inquiries, collaboration opportunities, or to learn more about the MEEM Lab, please contact Alice Rogers.

**Email:** [alice.rogers@vuw.ac.nz](mailto:alice.rogers@vuw.ac.nz)
---

## Student Opportunities & Scholarships

The MEEM Lab welcomes enthusiastic students at all levels (undergraduate, master's, PhD). Our students are funded through various scholarships and grants, including:

- [Wellington Doctoral Scholarship](https://www.wgtn.ac.nz/scholarships/current/wellington-doctoral-scholarships) (PhD)
- Victoria University of Wellington Master's and Undergraduate Research Scholarships
- Other external funding sources

To express your interest in joining the MEEM Lab, email Alice with a brief introduction, your research interests, and any relevant experience.

**Address:**  
School of Biological Sciences  
Victoria University of Wellington  
PO Box 600, Wellington 6140  
New Zealand

**Location:**  
Coastal Ecology Lab, Island Bay
